title: Watch: Dog who spent 72 days lost in mountains wins Hambone Award
comment: A golden retriever bolted on Christmas Day near Lake Tahoe and spent 72 days in the mountains before a shelter scanned his microchip. Thin but unhurt, he came home and then won a national award for it.
excerpt: This year s Hambone Award, presented for unusual pet insurance claims, was given to a golden retriever who spent 72 days lost in the mountains.

title: Watch: Coyote chases bear away from Los Angeles home
comment: A bear wandered up to a Los Angeles home and was promptly run off by a coyote roughly a fifth its size. The footage settles nothing about the food chain.
excerpt: A Los Angeles man s home security camera captured an unusual confrontation between a bear and a mother coyote.

title: Disabled Navy Veteran Sues Her Homeowners Association Over Fees, Debt Collection
comment: A disabled Navy veteran says her HOA's charges kept appearing and vanishing while she sat locked out of the resident portal for ten months. She sold the condo and is now suing; the association denies everything.
excerpt: Disabled Navy Veteran Sues Her Homeowners Association Over Fees, Debt Collection Military.com
